name: Tax Appeal Hearing Officer Decision
description: Decision on a taxpayer petition for refund or reassessment of an eligible tax.

preparers.name: Hearing Officer
preparers.detail: EIT Collector or Director of Business Services

deadline: Within 60 days of receipt of a complete and accurate petition
quote: The decision of the Hearing Officer shall be issued within sixty (60) days of the date a complete and accurate petition is received in the office of the Director of Business Services.
